description: Generate C/C++ or CUDA code from an AI model (PyTorch, LiteRT) using MATLAB Coder or GPU Coder. Use when the user wants to integrate an AI model into an application with code generation as the end goal — generating MEX, CUDA MEX, static library, dynamic library, or executable — or using the model in Simulink for simulation and code generation. Covers PyTorch ExportedProgram (.pt2) via loadPyTorchExportedProgram and LiteRT (.tflite) via loadLiteRTModel (R2026a+).
